questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
CHEM347 Drug Discovery and Development
COSC121 Introduction to Computer Programming
CHEM337 Organic Synthesis
SPRT126 Land Journeys and Ethics

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
All of them were good
in general:
SPRT126 Land Journeys and Ethics: very chill course, eith an  easy workload. No exam at the end of the semester, but an oral presentation in the middel of the course. includes a weekend trip in the wilderness which was fun.

COSC121 Introduction to Computer Programming: python programming. Basically a distance course, all work is done on your computer so no need to attend the time allocated to the course. I liked the course but the workload is the biggest of the courses i had abroad.

for chemistry i would recommend both the chemistry courses i had, very interesting and got good grades with low effort even if a lot of the stiff was new. Definietly recommend both, fun and easy.
